summary: Redirect to a playlist file URL
description: Returns an HTTP 302 redirect to the requested playlist file. This endpoint does not inherit the standard parent parameters; only client_id and id are required. An invalid request results in HTTP 404 or 500 errors. The audioformat parameter currently only supports 'mp3'.

parameters.name: client_id
parameters.description: A Client Id provided by devportal.jamendo.com.

parameters.name: audioformat
parameters.description: The audio format for the file URL. Currently only 'mp3' (192kbps) is supported.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The album ID for which the file redirect is requested.

notes: The endpoint performs an HTTP redirect rather than returning a JSON payload.
Only the 'mp3' audioformat is available at this time.
A missing or invalid client_id or id will result in a 404 or 500 error.
